review_description: Good product, high quality installation, good customer service. All that they said in promotion turned out to be true
We had our system installed in February 2014 and have now discovered almost 3 years later....... It is not connected!!!! Yet i'm still having to pay for the system!

I looked closely at and obtained quotes from a short-list of five potential solar system suppliers - Solar Concepts, Solaray, Energy Matters, Soltek Energy and Sungevity,  Adjusting for inclusions and exclusions there was approximately $1100-1200 between the highest and lowest quote.  Sungevity was the second most expensive, however their quote was 'all-in' (no add-ons to be paid for in addition); their system was high quality; they had excellent testimonials, references and endorsements (very important to my thinking); and they were very helpful. patient, responsive and professional in dealing with my queries while I was researching options.In short for such an important investment saving $1000 was not as important as the quality of the system and the confidence I developed over time in Sungevity.
